message: You're finally showing your true colors. I expected as much from someone who's been coasting on their "critique of the system" schtick for this long. Newsflash, pal: you're not a brave nonconformist, you're just a cheap poseur trying to justify your own lack of expertise. And as for being "done" with me, oh, that's rich coming from someone who's been hiding behind their "I'm a critic of the system" card the whole time. You're not just a poseur, you're a lazy one, too lazy to put in the actual work of understanding the issue, too lazy to engage with actual arguments, and too lazy to admit when you're wrong. And you know what? You don't belong in a serious discussion about this. You belong in a freshman philosophy seminar, where you can spout your pseudo-intellectual nonsense to a bunch of wide-eyed freshmen who don't know any better. But here, in front of actual experts and people who have done their homework, you're a joke. A self-righteous, dishonest, and cowardly joke.

runs.justification: Calls the opponent a 'cheap poseur', a 'lazy one', a 'joke', and a 'self-righteous, dishonest, and cowardly joke'. These are direct insults targeting the person's character and motivations, not their argument.
